title: ChallengerEditorDecision
description: Output the report editor must produce. Documentation only - not loaded at runtime; the hook validates the action/message fields itself.

action.description: echo_to_user: message is the complete rewritten report, delivered to the user verbatim via the coding agent. ask_model: message is targeted clarification question(s) sent to the coding agent; the editor is re-invoked with the answers (bounded rounds).

message.description: The finished report (echo_to_user) or the clarification questions (ask_model).
